Subject: ClutchTech demo — rapid exec window & agenda review

Hi Elena / Tomás,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to run through a short live demo and talk through how Redwood Inference can help ClutchTech reduce per-token latency for your chatbot use case.

We heard that you'd like both a VP-level and CTO-level presence for the walkthrough. We're happy to make that happen but note both of our execs are on tight windows next week. To move quickly, can you confirm which of these works on your side?

Option A — Executive handshake + tech deep-dive (single block):
  • Nov 29, 2027 — 11:30am–1:00pm PT (90 min) — VP + CTO join for first 30, then CTO deep-dive
Option B — Split cadence (exec snapshot + engineering deep-dive):
  • Nov 29, 2027 — 12:30pm–1:15pm PT (45 min exec summary) + 1:30pm–2:30pm PT (60 min engineering)

Attached is a short draft agenda for the session (demo-agenda.pdf). If you prefer a different cadence, tell us your top two windows and we'll prioritize.

On our side: Ben will lead the product demo; Laura will be on hand for SLA/contract touchpoints. I can push for VP availability but she only has a 12:30–1:15 PT slot today. If you confirm Option B we can hold both blocks for now.

Next steps: confirm preferred option and whether you want us to include a SOW placeholder during the call.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0122

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)

Thanks Monica — appreciate the options.

We do need both our VP (Marina Kim) and CTO (Diego Alvarez) on the call for budget and architecture sign-off. They travel a lot so tight windows are fine, but we prefer the split cadence (Option B) so execs get a concise briefing first.

Question: can the engineering deep-dive include a short segment on your model routing/fallback behavior and an SLA summary? Also we will want a placeholder SOW to review during or immediately after the call — can you circulate a short draft before EOD?

If you can hold both blocks for now, we'll confirm which exact times work within the next 90 minutes.

Elena — great, thanks for the quick reply.

We can do Option B and I've tentatively held both blocks today while we lock attendees. Quick notes / commitment from our side:
  • Exec snapshot (12:30–1:15 PT): Monica will intro value props and commercial asks; VP (Avery Johnson) can join for the full 45 min but only if we keep it tight.
  • Engineering deep-dive (1:30–2:30 PT): Ben will lead; CTO-focused segments on routing/fallback and KV cache behavior included. Laura will sit in for SLA and procurement questions.

I've attached a short SOW draft (SOW-Draft-v1.docx) that outlines scope and an initial pricing band — it's intentionally high level so we can iterate after the call. If you want any particular clause pre-highlighted (data retention, audit logs, private deployment), reply with the sections and I'll ask legal to prioritize.

If that looks good, confirm the two blocks and we'll send calendar invites with dial-in and recording permission. If your execs absolutely cannot do both blocks in one day, tell us the single best 90-min window and we'll switch to Option A.

Thanks — aiming to get this confirmed before noon PT.
Monica
